units.source_text: “嘿，你这个人呀……怎么回事，像个白痴嘛！”

en.t: Hey, what is wrong with you... You are acting like an idiot!

units.source_text: 阿光在说话的时候几乎没瞧对方一眼，说完她才用疲惫无力的目光望了望阿留。

en.t: As Ah Guang spoke, she hardly looked at the other person at all; only after she finished did she glance at Ah Liu with tired, powerless eyes.

units.source_text: 她感到本来就是小脸盘的阿留，面孔显得更小了。

en.t: She felt that Ah Liu, whose face had always been small, now looked even smaller.

units.source_text: 前额发光，头发稀疏，眼神茫然若失。

en.t: His forehead shone, his hair was thin, and his eyes looked vacant, as if he had lost himself.
